environment.description: Deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with task role restricted by IAM permission boundary arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoExecBoundary. Container image built with cargo profile release using jemalloc (tikv-jemallocator 0.5) with background_thread:true,tcache:false,abort_conf:true. The ECS task definition specifies linuxParameters.initProcessEnabled=true with a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented with deny on ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev). Credential rotation is handled by an external Lambda triggered by EventBridge every 60s which calls the internal /rotate endpoint via VPC-internal ALB with listener rule requiring X-Rotation-Secret header matching Secrets Manager value rotated independently every 300s. The ALB security group only permits ingress from the Lambda's VPC endpoint ENI on port 8080 for the /rotate path. Client-facing traffic routes through CloudFront with AWS-managed origin request policy that strips Authorization headers exceeding 2048 bytes and enforces TLS 1.3 only.

config.rotation_access: Lambda-only via internal ALB with X-Rotation-Secret header validation
config.alb_security_group: ingress only from Lambda VPC endpoint ENI for /rotate
config.client_ingress: CloudFront -> ALB, Authorization header max 2048 bytes, TLS 1.3
